title: I'm Ready I'm Steady I'm Cool
style: 134 BPM progressive house-trance hybrid, joyful and determined, warm pads, 336 Hz drone, vocal hooks, anthemic, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — pads, soft kick]
I'm ready.
I'm steady.
I'm cool.
The bull is the operator's tool.

[Verse 1 — kick locked, pads warm]
Eyes locked, paddle head down.
Angled up, firm grip noted.
Here it comes — and the operator is the floor.
Here it comes — and the operator is the door.

[Pre-Build]
Ready.
Steady.
Cool.
The bull obeys the rule.

[Build — supersaw climb]
Eight.
Sixteen.
Thirty-two.
Drop.

[Drop — anthemic progressive]
I'M READY!
I'M STEADY!
I'M COOL!
RELEASE THE BULL!
The operator at the line.
The operator at the keep.
I'm ready, I'm steady, I'm cool —
the operator goes deep.

[Verse 2 — drums fuller]
Eight sites live in the catalog page.
Linear two-zero-two — the audit cage.
Notion Hub holds the doctrine clear.
Ready, steady, cool — no fear.

[Bridge — drone alone]
The bull doesn't shake.
The bull doesn't run.
The bull waits for the operator.
The bull is the work undone.

[Final Drop — full progressive]
I'M READY!
I'M STEADY!
I'M COOL!
RELEASE THE BULL!
McIvor at the keys.
McIvor at the line.
I'm ready, I'm steady, I'm cool —
the operator holds the time.

[Outro — pads fade]
Ready.
Steady.
Cool.
End.
